note: State shapes the prototype persists or projects, mapped to 08's delta areas. ACD-434 field names are reused verbatim where the concept touches them; unknown values stay unknown (never fabricated).

deltas.shape: sentAt (UTC ISO) stored; locale rendering via Intl; Started/Completed/first-visible derivable per turn
runtime.workedSeconds, runtime.totalElapsedSeconds; workedLabel renders Working for/Worked for; waits excluded from worked per canon
local.route (effective) + local.requestedRoute {provider, account, model, reason}
Edit loads canonical body into draft; original message remains; receipt records supersession intent
view.expandedMessages{}, view.expandedGroups{} — UI-local view state per 08's escape valve, persisted for mount continuity
search {query, scope, activeResult {threadId, messageId, at}}; jumps widen initialVisibleMessageCount
deltas.storage: session state; scope persists across mounts

deltas.shape: lens.selections {msgId: mute|focus|subcompact-pending|subcompact}; receipts [{at, op, count, note}]
activeGoal {status, blocked{cause,scope,attempted,whyStopped,nextSafeAction}, pendingEdit{objective,impact}, completionReceipt}

questionnaires [{id,title,status(preparing|incomplete|queued|submitting|submitted|cancelled),currentQuestionIndex,questions[{id,prompt,kind,required,options,selected}],skipped{},freeform{},resolvedAt}]
draftState {currentText, attachments[], revisionHistory[{savedAt,text}] (bounded 12, deduplicated)}
subagentGroups [{label,state,counts{working,complete,blocked,waiting},agents[{name,task,currentActivity,status,workedSeconds,route}]}]
crew {wave, waves, concurrent, queued} + forecast {usedPercent, windowResetMinutes, sustainable, waves, note}
artifacts [{id,title,kind,projectPath,openTarget}]; selection {openId,status,byThread{}}
sync.outbox [{id,threadId,text,idempotencyKey,queuedAt,state}]; sync.replayLog [keys]; lastReplayAt
local.bsd (off|auto|on), local.bsdScope (This turn|Current thread), local.bsdState (idle|evaluating|silent result|advice|duplicate-suppressed|timeout|unavailable|quota-limited)
attachment {id,name,size,cls(Native|PM transformed|Alternate model|Unsupported),detail}
approval card with scope (Once|Thread|Goal/PlanningRun|persistent pair) + receipt; one-time never persists
warnings {kind: resource, title, body, actions}; ops summary strings (ports, worktrees, tests, debug, backups, snapshots)
receipts [{at, kind, title, detail}] — bounded 40 persisted; title-bar count stays canonical
outbox idempotencyKey per queued command; cross-thread request idempotencyKey; replayLog is the applied set
context_estimate is the only 434 field the ring consumes; usage_event_ref/attempt_id/tool_call_id are represented in fixture activity records as stage identity only — no chat-local cost math
